description:
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotes are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 

 Solicitation number 1240LP27Q0014 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for snow and ice removal services at the Sopris Ranger Station, 620 Main Street, Carbondale, CO 81623, for a base period and four option periods. 

 This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 561790. The small business size standard is $9.0 million. This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible small business sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. 

  Questions are due Monday, November 30, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. Mountain Time. 
 
Quotes are due Friday, December 4, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. Mountain Time. 
 
Submit questions and quotes by email to Westley.Bisson@usda.gov.  

 Periods of Performance: 
Base Period: December 15, 2026 - April 30, 2027 
Option Period 1: November 1, 2027 - April 30, 2028 
Option Period 2: November 1, 2028 - April 30, 2029 
Option Period 3: November 1, 2029 - April 30, 2030 
Option Period 4: November 1, 2030 - April 30, 2031 

 See the attached solicitation for full instructions and requirements.
